intent: Mutating canary: link entities for 25 edgeless durable memories via API

steps.label: forge-entity-backfill-canary-25
steps.sql: SELECT id, type, project, substr(content, 1, 240) AS content_preview, timestamp FROM memories WHERE type IN ('"fact"', '"solution"', '"decision"', '"pattern"', '"project_context"', '"error_lesson"', '"conversation"', '"knowledge"') AND (superseded_by IS NULL OR superseded_by = '') AND id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT src_memory_id FROM edges) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT ?
